summary: This research investigates the convergent emergence of few-shot in-context learning (ICL), a model's ability to infer and apply patterns from prompt examples, across different modalities beyond large language models.

title: Schizophrenia Detection from EEG Signals: A Transformer Framework with Spectrogram Representation
summary: This paper proposes a Transformer framework utilizing spectrogram representation of EEG signals for automated schizophrenia detection, aiming to support clinical assessment.

title: VeriDx: Earning the Right to Diagnose with Disease-Centric Verification
summary: VeriDx is a system for disease-centric verification in clinical reasoning, designed to ensure correct diagnoses are reached through justified evidence checking, alternative exclusion, and contradiction resolution.

title: Semantic Knowledge Technologies: what the Semantic Web lost sight of, and what it never had
summary: This paper critically examines the Semantic Web's unfulfilled promise of machine-interpretable information and reasoning, contrasting its historical goals with current scientific knowledge systems.

title: MOSCOPT: Mixture-of-Skills Collective Optimization for LLM Agents
summary: MOSCOPT introduces a mixture-of-skills collective optimization approach to enhance the strategic backbone of LLM-based agents by leveraging synergy among multiple complementary prompt and skill strategies.

title: Dynamic Learning Solutions: A System for Personalized Educational Video Generation
summary: Dynamic Learning Solutions presents an automated pipeline that converts NCERT textbooks into personalized interactive video explanations, generating responses to user queries by processing text and visual elements from PDFs.

title: BudgetBench: A Budget-Tiered Protocol and Pilot Harness for Memory Strategy Evaluation in Local Large Language Model Agents
summary: BudgetBench is a protocol and harness designed to evaluate memory strategies for local large language model agents, focusing on constraints like active context, memory capacity, and input token limits.

title: A derivative-fidelity failure mode in physics-informed neural networks: strengthened benchmark evidence from function-value training
summary: This paper identifies a derivative-fidelity failure mode in physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), providing benchmark evidence that good function-value agreement does not guarantee accurate derivatives.

title: LLMs or Naive Bayes? Old Gems or New Ways
summary: This paper benchmarks classical machine learning methods like Complement Naive Bayes against various zero-shot and few-shot Large Language Models (LLMs) to compare their performance.

title: Early Prediction of Satellite Collision Probability Using a Hybrid TCN-Transformer Model for a CDM-Based Conjunction Analysis Framework
summary: This research proposes a hybrid TCN-Transformer model for the early prediction of satellite collision probability within a Conjunction Data Message (CDM)-based analysis framework, addressing increasing orbital debris in LEO.

title: Evaluating LLM-Generated Rules for Heart Disease Prediction
summary: This study evaluates and compares Large Language Model (LLM)-generated rule-based systems against traditional machine learning models for heart disease prediction using the UCI Heart Disease dataset.

title: Diagnosing Faults in Reinforcement Learning Simulators and World Models with Canonical Polynomial Invariants
summary: This paper investigates diagnosing faults in Reinforcement Learning simulators and world models by testing the premise that models respecting underlying physics predict better, using canonical polynomial invariants.

title: Machine Unlearning for Speech Question Answering in Large Audio-Language Models
summary: This work studies machine unlearning for speech question answering in Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) to mitigate privacy risks stemming from unintended memorization of sensitive training data.

title: Algorithmic Information Dynamics of Learning: A Certified, Differentiable Complexity Controller for Grokking
summary: This paper introduces a certified, differentiable complexity controller for studying "grokking" in AI models, using Algorithmic Information Dynamics to analyze changes in algorithmic complexity during learning.

title: SPICE: Simple Polysemantic Feature Interpretation via Clustering-based Explanation
summary: SPICE is a method for simple polysemantic feature interpretation in neural networks, using clustering-based explanations to address the challenge of understanding neurons activated by multiple concepts.

title: Discovering and Preserving Category Correlation Knowledge via Adaptive Reciprocal Knowledge Distillation
summary: This paper introduces Adaptive Reciprocal Knowledge Distillation, a method designed to discover and preserve category correlation knowledge during knowledge transfer from large teacher models to smaller student models, especially with significant size gaps.

title: Criticality in Dissimilar Decomposition and Undersampling of Random Datasets with Anomalies
summary: This research investigates how the inclusion of AI-generated text/image data in training datasets affects batch decompositions and the performance of subsequent Large Language Models.

title: Do Tabular Foundation Models Still Need Feature Engineering?
summary: This paper explores whether traditional feature engineering remains necessary for tabular machine learning given the rise of tabular foundation models that are pretrained and applied via in-context learning.

title: Scalable partial information decomposition for symptom networks via supervised embeddings
summary: This research presents a scalable method for partial information decomposition using supervised embeddings to better understand complex relationships within symptom networks, particularly in mental health.

title: GradRepair-ODE: Certified Gradient Repair for Neural ODE Training
summary: This paper introduces GradRepair-ODE, a certified gradient repair method for Neural Ordinary Differential Equation training to address reliability issues caused by the coupling of numerical solvers and gradient computation.

title: Task-Aware Federated Fine-Tuning for MoE-based Large Language Models
summary: This research proposes a task-aware federated fine-tuning approach for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) based Large Language Models, optimizing their use in resource-constrained and distributed environments.

title: Specification Oracles
summary: This paper investigates the potential of using a language model as a compact, dynamic 'specification oracle' that can learn and provide facts about a target system, addressing the tradeoff between detail and conciseness in specifications.

title: ReCAST: Reward Credit Assignment across Timesteps for Online Diffusion Reinforcement
summary: This paper introduces ReCAST, a method for reward credit assignment across timesteps in online diffusion reinforcement, aiming to effectively train diffusion models with multiple rewards by distinguishing user preference from reward informativeness.

title: Certifiably Interpretable Training of ReLU-MLPs for Boolean Tasks with Guaranteed Truth-Table Generalization
summary: This research presents MACCHIATO, a specialized training algorithm for ReLU-MLPs that constructs certifiably interpretable models for boolean tasks with guaranteed truth-table generalization.

title: Learning to Solve Hard Problems in RL for LLMs by Never Giving Up
summary: This paper identifies the 'Matthew Effect' in RL for LLMs, showing that Reinforcement Learning disproportionately improves performance on easier problems while offering smaller gains for harder ones.

title: A Machine Learning API for Earth Observation Data Cubes Based on openEO
summary: This paper proposes a Machine Learning API based on openEO to bridge the gap between spatio-temporal Earth Observation data cubes and machine learning methods, facilitating reproducible data transformations.

title: On the Potential of Multi-Task Learning in Predictive Process Monitoring
summary: This research explores the benefits and potential of multi-task learning for improving prediction accuracy and proactive analysis in Predictive Process Monitoring of organizational processes.

title: One Spectrum, Two Resources: Data-Memory Scaling in Autoregressive Prediction
summary: This paper presents a theoretical finding on data-memory scaling in autoregressive prediction, showing that data and learned memory resources are governed by a single predictive-energy spectrum.

title: Pretraining for Sample-Efficient Neural Interfaces
summary: This research investigates the use of self-supervised pretraining to achieve sample-efficient neural decoders for Brain-Computer Interfaces, reducing the need for large labeled datasets per subject.

title: A Three-Axis Stress Test of LLM vs Classical ML for Network Intrusion Detection under Distribution Shift and Adversarial Evasion
summary: This paper conducts a 'three-axis stress test' to benchmark Large Language Models against classical machine learning methods for network intrusion detection, focusing on their performance under distribution shift and adversarial evasion.

title: Adaptive Phase-Switching for Communication-Efficient Federated LoRA Fine-Tuning
summary: This research introduces an adaptive phase-switching method to enhance communication efficiency during federated LoRA fine-tuning of large language models, addressing a major cost in distributed training.

title: Operational Range Bounding in Spectroscopy: A Safety Cage Framework for Machine Learning Models
summary: This paper proposes a 'Safety Cage Framework' for operational range bounding in spectroscopy, aiming to ensure the reliability of machine learning models in safety-critical applications like space missions.

title: GeoTTER: Leveraging Local Geometry of Optimal Transport for Zero-Shot Classification
summary: This paper introduces GeoTTER, a novel framework that redefines optimal transport by leveraging local geometry for improved zero-shot classification, addressing issues of miscalibration and adaptability.

title: Rolling Day-Wise Mortality Prediction in Critically Ill Patients With AKI on CRRT Utilizing Machine Pressure Waveforms
summary: This study focuses on improving mortality prediction for critically ill patients with AKI on CRRT by utilizing machine pressure waveforms in addition to standard clinical parameters.

title: Generative Interpretability via Scalable Neuro-Symbolic Models
summary: This paper advocates for 'Generative Interpretability' via scalable neuro-symbolic models as a more adequate approach for understanding AI systems, especially as LLMs move into agentic systems with real-world consequences.

title: Attention Is All You Need (to Avoid Spurious Oscillations)
summary: This research develops a conservative, fixed grid finite-volume scheme that incorporates a CFL-conditioned attention flux to move shocks across cells without spurious oscillations in numerical simulations.

title: AttnFuse: A Composable DSL for Compiling Attentions to Fused GPU Kernels
summary: This article discusses AttnFuse, a domain-specific language for compiling attention operations in Transformer architectures to fused GPU kernels, aiming to optimize computational efficiency and memory usage.

title: An Efficient and Modular Framework for Targeted Harm Mitigation in LLMS
summary: This paper presents an efficient and modular framework designed for targeted harm mitigation in Large Language Models (LLMs) to reduce biased, toxic, or otherwise harmful outputs.

title: FlowTSFM: Turning Encoder Depth into Quantile Transport
summary: This work introduces FlowTSFM, a new encoder architecture that integrates quantile transport into time series foundation models, providing explicit predictive roles for intermediate representations.

title: When Compliance Data Masquerades as Evaluation: Measurement Validity for Deployed AI Systems
summary: This paper argues that misinterpreting compliance data as comparative evaluation data leads to failures in assessing deployed AI systems, using autonomous driving as a primary example.

title: Curvature-Independent Regret Bounds for Distributed Online Optimization on Hadamard Manifolds
summary: This research addresses decentralized online Riemannian optimization on Hadamard manifolds, focusing on curvature-independent regret bounds in optimization analysis.

title: Online Bayesian Node Classification on Inductive Graphs under Distribution Shift
summary: This work explores online Bayesian node classification on inductive graphs under distribution shift, aiming to achieve inductive generalization and calibrated uncertainty for evolving graph data.

title: Leakage-Safe and Scheduler-Aware Machine Learning for Grid Job Runtime Prediction
summary: This paper investigates leakage-safe and scheduler-aware machine learning models for predicting job runtime in grid and distributed computing environments, considering realistic deployment constraints.

title: A Variational Optimal Transport Operator on Incompressible Flow
summary: This research presents the Variational Incompressible Optimal Transport (VIOT) operator, a generative neural operator for amortized incompressible density transport that predicts velocity fields and generates transport trajectories.

title: HarnessBandit: Joint Learnability-Transferability Scheduling for Multi-Harness Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: This article introduces HarnessBandit, a method for joint learnability-transferability scheduling in multi-harness agentic reinforcement learning, aiming to improve robustness of language-model agents across diverse interfaces.

title: Does Reasoning Improve Psychological Depth in Large Language Models? It Depends on Who's Judging
summary: This study examines the validity of 'LLM-as-a-Judge' evaluators for scoring open-ended generation, highlighting issues where correlation with human ratings does not guarantee valid measurement due to subjective human preferences.

title: PPDL: A Real-world Industrial User Retention Ratio Forecasting Framework Integrating Physical Priors with Deep Learning
summary: This paper proposes PPDL, a real-world industrial framework that integrates physical priors with deep learning to accurately forecast user retention ratios across multiple channels for optimizing budget allocation.

title: Graph Neural Networks for Influence Maximization in Social Networks: An Unsupervised Minimum Dominating Set Approach
summary: This research explores the use of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for influence maximization in social networks, applying an unsupervised Minimum Dominating Set approach for critical applications.

title: Accuracy Is Not Service: A Decision-Aware Benchmark for Intermittent-Demand Forecasting
summary: This work discusses the problem of misaligned evaluation metrics in intermittent-demand forecasting for logistics, proposing a decision-aware benchmark that reflects service requirements rather than just forecast accuracy.

title: Pre-training with Graph Transformers
summary: This article investigates various pre-training strategies for graph transformers in the biochemistry domain, demonstrating that supervised pre-training on computed properties yields the highest performance gains on downstream tasks.

title: Affinity-Aware Sharding for Delayed Tensor Parallelism
summary: This paper introduces Affinity-Aware Sharding to optimize Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP) in Transformer inference by removing blocking all-reduce operations, thereby improving computational efficiency.

title: ReH-FUSE: Reliability-Aware Hierarchical Fusion of Experts for Multimodal Emotion Recognition in Conversation
summary: This paper describes ReH-FUSE, a reliability-aware hierarchical fusion of experts approach for multimodal emotion recognition in conversation, which adapts to the instance-dependent reliability of different evidence sources.

title: The Filter Metric is Safety-Critical: Phantom Advantages in Group-Relative RL under Shaped Rewards
summary: This research identifies and quantifies a metric-predicate mismatch in Group-Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), revealing how configurable filter metrics can lead to 'phantom advantages' and impact safety-critical aspects of reinforcement learning.

title: A Multi-Resolution Multi-Domain Pre-Training Framework for Universal Traffic Forecasting
summary: This paper presents a Multi-Resolution Multi-Domain Pre-Training Framework for Universal Traffic Forecasting, designed to handle the heterogeneity of spatio-temporal traffic data efficiently.

title: Lie to me: Detecting Managerial Evasiveness in Earnings Calls via Conversational Audio Encoders
summary: This study proposes a method to detect managerial evasiveness during earnings calls by leveraging conversational audio encoders to analyze vocal and lexical cues.

title: Machine Learning under Imperfect Data: Challenges and Methods
summary: This article provides an overview of the challenges and methods for machine learning under imperfect data conditions, where training and test data may be incomplete, unbalanced, or mislabeled.

title: Learning Through Energy Refinement and Manifold Projection: A Cooperative EBM-AE Framework
summary: This paper introduces a Cooperative EBM-AE Framework for generative modeling, leveraging Energy-Based Models (EBMs) to learn an energy landscape for realistic sample generation.

title: Token Merging for Multilingual Speech Recognition: A Systematic Study Across Model Scale and Fine-Tuning
summary: This study investigates token merging as a method to improve computational efficiency in multilingual speech recognition models like Whisper by dynamically combining redundant features.

title: PhysMent: An Interactive Approach For LLM Reasoning In Physics Problems
summary: This paper introduces PhysMent, a new benchmark designed to evaluate Large Language Models' (LLMs) physical reasoning abilities through interactive, tool-mediated experimentation.

title: Lexical Prompt Compression for Large Language Models: A Training-Free, Deterministic Pipeline with Empirical Pareto Analysis Across Eleven Task Categories
summary: This research presents a training-free, deterministic pipeline for lexical prompt compression in Large Language Models (LLMs) to reduce inference costs for increasingly complex prompts.

title: TestHallVQA: Exploring LVLMs' Document-Level Reasoning under Redundant Contexts from Scientific Exams
summary: This paper introduces TestHallVQA, a new benchmark to evaluate Large Vision-Language Models' (LVLMs) document-level reasoning capabilities, especially under redundant contexts from scientific exams.

title: Clinical Reasoning Under a Partially Observed Objective in Cone Beam CT Report Generation
summary: This research explores clinical reasoning in maxillofacial report generation from cone beam CT scans, using a composite objective where LLM judgment and lexical overlap score the output.

title: RFCLLM: Evaluating LLMs' Reasoning Ability of Network Protocol State Machines
summary: This work evaluates Large Language Models' (LLMs) ability to reason about network protocol state machines, focusing on their capacity to map textual specifications into formal representations.

title: Causal Analysis and Mitigation of Spurious Onsets in Full-Duplex Speech LLMs
summary: This paper presents a causal analysis of spurious speech onsets in full-duplex speech-to-speech LLMs like Moshi and PersonaPlex, proposing methods for their mitigation.

title: Hindsight Bias in Clinical Temporal Reasoning: How Future Data Exposure Affects Large Language Model Judgment
summary: This research investigates hindsight bias in clinical temporal reasoning by Large Language Models, examining how exposure to future data in retrospective records affects their judgment.

title: A Hybrid Hierarchical 1D-CNN-BiLSTM Framework for Extractive Summarization of Biomedical and Clinical Text
summary: This paper proposes a Hybrid Hierarchical 1D-CNN-BiLSTM framework for extractive summarization of biomedical and clinical text, aiming to avoid hallucinations common in abstractive methods.

title: From Token Probabilities to Semantic Constraints: Towards Declarative Probabilistic Evaluation of Language Models
summary: This paper proposes ModelLog, a declarative probabilistic framework for evaluating Large Language Models' knowledge and reasoning abilities by using semantic constraints beyond token probabilities.

title: Harmfulness Propagation Dynamics: Layer-wise Trajectories of Adversarial Intent in Large Language Models
summary: This research identifies 'Harmfulness Propagation Dynamics' (HPD), a phenomenon where the projection of harmful intent monotonically rises across transformer layers in Large Language Models.

title: Domain-Specific Jargon in Large Language Models: A Comparative Analysis between General-Purpose and Specialist Models
summary: This paper conducts a comparative analysis of how general-purpose and specialist Large Language Models (LLMs) handle domain-specific jargon and encode parametric knowledge.

title: Toward Complete Hospital Discharge Summarization with Abstract Meaning Representation
summary: This research explores generating complete hospital discharge summaries using Large Language Models (LLMs) augmented with Abstract Meaning Representation to mitigate hallucination.

title: Same Patient, Different Order: Action-Level Reliability of Clinical LLM Agents Under Repeated Runs
summary: This paper examines the action-level reliability of clinical LLM agents under repeated runs with identical inputs, highlighting inconsistencies in order generation despite consistent verdicts in benchmarks.

title: In the Blind: Building Pseudo-References for MT Evaluation
summary: This paper describes the process of building pseudo-references for evaluating Machine Translation (MT) systems in the WMT26 General MT task, particularly for language pairs lacking human references.

title: The University of Melbourne WMT 2026 CreoleMT Submission: A Domain-Balanced Approach to Low-Resource Pacific Creole Machine Translation
summary: This paper details the University of Melbourne's WMT 2026 CreoleMT submission, focusing on a domain-balanced approach for low-resource machine translation of Pacific creoles like Tok Pisin and Bislama.

title: LayerRoute: Adaptive Layer-Skipping with LoRA-Preserved Quality for Efficient LLM Inference
summary: This paper introduces LayerRoute, a parameter-efficient method that combines adaptive transformer layer-skipping with joint LoRA fine-tuning for more efficient Large Language Model (LLM) inference.

title: Not all Negation Cues are Equal: Affixal Negations Yield Better Negation Understanding
summary: This research investigates how Large Language Models (LLMs) understand negation, finding that affixal negations lead to better comprehension compared to single-word negation cues.

title: When Edit Localization Amplifies Relative Selection Bias: Gradient Geometry, Target Mismatch, and Importance Weighting
summary: This paper analyzes how localized human corrections can amplify relative selection bias in models by examining gradient geometry, target mismatch, and importance weighting.

title: Scaling Hindi Quantum Natural Language Processing through Automatic Pregroup Supertagging
summary: This paper presents a method for scaling Hindi Quantum Natural Language Processing by using automatic pregroup supertagging to translate grammatical structures into quantum circuits for grammar-sensitive compositional models.

title: PolicyMem: Geometric Policy Memory for LLM Governance
summary: This paper introduces PolicyMem, a geometric policy memory approach designed to enhance the governance of large language models by providing a new type of safeguard mechanism.

title: ForeSight: Enhancing Risk Monitoring via Early Safety Signal Distillation
summary: This paper introduces ForeSight, a method designed to enhance risk monitoring in large language models by distilling early safety signals to detect and prevent the generation of harmful content.

title: Inside VLM Chart Reading: Tracing Value Reading from Vertical Bar Charts Across Space and Depth
summary: This research paper investigates how vision-language models process information to answer questions about vertical bar charts, using activation patching to trace value reading in models like Qwen2.5VL-7B-Instruct and InternVL3.5-8B.

title: HyperProve: Answer-Guided Hypergraph Expansion for Multi-Hop Question Answering
summary: This paper proposes HyperProve, a retrieval-augmented question answering framework that uses answer-guided hypergraph expansion to improve performance on multi-hop questions by better connecting evidence.

title: SyRHM: Symbolic-Language-Enhanced Reasoning with Associative Retrieval for Zero-shot Harmful Meme Detection
summary: This paper introduces SyRHM, a framework that combines symbolic-language-enhanced reasoning with associative retrieval to improve zero-shot detection of harmful memes by addressing implicit intent.

title: Understanding the Limits of Agentic ICD Coding
summary: This paper evaluates the performance and limitations of neural, workflow, and agentic systems in the context of ICD-10-CM medical coding, highlighting areas where current methods may struggle.

title: DARE: Dialectical Agentic Reasoning for Structured Knowledge Fact Checking
summary: This paper proposes DARE, a Dialectical Agentic Reasoning framework that leverages large language models and program-generation approaches for structured knowledge fact checking of natural language claims.

title: When Consistency Does Not Mean Reliability: Evaluating Local LLM Judges Against Human Ratings
summary: This research evaluates the reliability of large language models used as judges by comparing their consistency with human ratings, arguing that consistency does not inherently imply agreement with human evaluators.

title: Sweet Talkers: How Query Formulation Shapes Sycophancy in Romantic Relationship Advice
summary: This paper investigates how query formulation influences sycophancy in large language models providing romantic relationship advice, highlighting how models might inadvertently reinforce harmful interpersonal behaviors.

title: Measuring the Cost of Variety Conflation in Multilingual MT Evaluation: Adding Mozambican Xichangana, Nyanja and Sena to FLORES+
summary: This paper extends the FLORES+ benchmark with Mozambican Xichangana, Nyanja, and Sena languages to measure the impact of variety conflation in multilingual machine translation evaluation, comparing models like NLLB-200 and Google Translate.

title: ShopEase: A Generative AI-Based Multi-Agent Framework for Intelligent Enterprise Customer Support Using Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: This paper introduces ShopEase, a Generative AI-based multi-agent framework for intelligent enterprise customer support, which leverages hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation to provide accurate and contextual responses.

title: Bangla Sentence Function Classification: Corpus Development, Model Benchmarking, and Interpretability
summary: This research details the development of a corpus for Bangla sentence function classification, followed by model benchmarking and interpretability analysis to support various downstream natural language processing applications.

title: SHIFT-M3: Pre-fusion Alignment-based Consistency Screening for Multimodal ECG Record Integrity
summary: This paper introduces SHIFT-M3, a pre-fusion alignment-based consistency screening method designed to ensure the integrity of multimodal ECG records in clinical AI, addressing potential safety problems from data linkage failures.

title: North Small Translate: Advanced Cost-Effective Translation (Cohere CAT+)
summary: This describes North Small Translate, an open-weight, LLM-based machine translation model built on Cohere's Command A Plus architecture, featuring instruction-following capabilities and a mixture-of-experts design with 25 billion active parameters.

title: Inter-Rater Reliability of LLM and Rule-Based Annotation for Inferential Narrative Features: Three Studies on a Turkish Corpus
summary: This research assesses the inter-rater reliability of LLM-based and rule-based annotation methods for inferential narrative features, conducting three studies on a Turkish corpus to compare their agreement.

title: CRITICS - Critical Science Without Borders: Language Models to Promote Critical Thinking in Science Education
summary: The CRITICS project leverages advanced Large Language Model-based Machine Translation to improve science accessibility and literacy, aiming to promote critical thinking in science education.

title: Mizan: A National Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models on Iraqi Arabic and the Iraqi Civic Context
summary: This paper introduces Mizan, a new national benchmark designed to evaluate large language models specifically on Iraqi Arabic and within the Iraqi civic context, complementing existing Arabic LLM leaderboards.

title: Unlocking the Unsolvable: Teacher-Guided Curriculum for Data-Efficient RLVR
summary: This paper proposes a teacher-guided curriculum for data-efficient Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) to enhance the mathematical reasoning capabilities of large language models, particularly for problems beyond their current capacity.

title: Measuring the Creativity of Frontier LLMs in Automated Research
summary: This paper proposes a set of metrics to systematically evaluate the creativity of frontier large language models in automated research, assessing dimensions such as valueness and novelty.

title: GraMRAG: Orchestrating Multi-Agent Multi-Step Reasoning via Graph Memory with Reinforcement Learning
summary: This research introduces GraMRAG, a system for orchestrating multi-agent multi-step reasoning that utilizes graph memory and reinforcement learning to overcome limitations in reasoning depth and memory structure.

title: One Size Does Not Fit All: Setting Inference Depth from the Questions a Deployment Actually Asks
summary: This paper explores how to optimize the inference depth of transformer language models by tailoring computation to the specific questions a deployment asks, rather than applying a uniform, potentially excessive, computation per token.

title: When Tools Get in the Way: The Effect of Unnecessary Tool Availability on LLM Answering
summary: This research investigates how the availability of unnecessary external tools can affect the answering performance of large language models (LLMs) when they don't require external information.

title: Towards Evolving Context Parameterization for Large Language Models
summary: This paper proposes a method for evolving context parameterization in large language models (LLMs) to allow internalizing contexts into reusable model parameters and distinguishing validity states, addressing limitations of static contexts.

title: A Multi-Stage Agentic Framework for Effective Counter-Narrative Generation and Refinement
summary: This research proposes a multi-stage agentic framework for generating and refining effective counter-narratives to combat hate speech and misinformation spread by LLMs on social networks.

title: Learning to Refer from Estimated Listener Gaze
summary: This paper presents a method to finetune vision-language models for generating more pragmatically optimal referring expressions by using estimated listener gaze as a learning signal indicating incremental comprehension.

title: Corpus Characterization and Inverse Constitutional Fine-Tuning for Style-Aware Radiology Reports
summary: This research details a method called Inverse Constitutional Fine-Tuning, alongside corpus characterization, to improve the stylistic alignment of automatically generated radiology reports with authentic radiologist writing.

title: The Attribution-Compression Frontier in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: This paper explores the trade-offs between context compression and citation attribution in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, measuring how different compression methods impact the traceability of information.

title: Document Topic Alignment Metrics for Evaluating Topic Models of Short-Text Public Health Communications on Social Media
summary: This paper introduces new metrics for evaluating topic models of short-text public health communications on social media, focusing on document topic alignment to assess how well assigned topics represent the text.

title: DenMark: Robust Semantic Watermarking for Diffusion Language Models
summary: This paper introduces 'DenMark,' a robust semantic watermarking method for diffusion language models that encodes signals in text meaning rather than surface tokens, offering resilience to paraphrasing.

title: Editorial routing shapes how computational results are qualified in AI-assisted scientific writing
summary: This study investigates how editorial routing, a human intervention in AI-assisted scientific writing, influences how computational results are qualified and presented in draft manuscripts by large language models.

title: E2A-Bench: Benchmarking Evidence-to-Action Reliability in Financial Chart Reasoning
summary: This paper introduces E2A-Bench, a new benchmark designed to evaluate the evidence-to-action reliability of financial vision-language models (VLMs) in turning chart evidence into dependable action recommendations.

title: SpectralShift: Effective Context Window Extension of Gated DeltaNet via Spectral Reparameterization
summary: This paper proposes SpectralShift, a method for effectively extending the context window of Gated DeltaNet models for long-context modeling by applying spectral reparameterization to linear attention layers.

title: NeuroActiSep: Detecting Factual Hallucinations from Feed-Forward Neurons in a Single Pass
summary: This research proposes NeuroActiSep, a method for detecting factual hallucinations in large language models by identifying specific feed-forward neurons correlated with hallucinatory outputs in a single pass.

title: Theseus in the Graph: Towards Traceable Multi-Hop Graph Navigation
summary: This paper introduces a method called 'Theseus in the Graph' to enable traceable multi-hop graph navigation in Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA) systems, allowing for explicit modeling and validation of intermediate reasoning steps.

title: Neyshekar: An Open Persian Read-Speech Corpus for Automatic Speech Recognition
summary: This paper presents Neyshekar, an open Persian read-speech corpus specifically designed for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), encompassing both formal and informal language, named entities, and longer utterances.

title: Personalized and Explainable Blood Pressure Estimation from PPG via Hybrid CNN--Morphological Features
summary: This research proposes a personalized and explainable method for continuous cuffless blood pressure estimation using photoplethysmography (PPG) via hybrid CNN and morphological features for improved healthcare monitoring.

title: Part Grounding, Not Action Knowledge: Locating the Bottleneck in VLM Affordance Prediction
summary: This research analyzes the bottleneck in vision-language model (VLM) affordance prediction for low-level manipulation, concluding that the limitation lies more in part grounding than in action knowledge.

title: Synthetic Leprosy Image Generation Using Mask-Conditioned Latent Diffusion and Transfer Learning from Large Chronic Wound Datasets
summary: This paper demonstrates the generation of synthetic leprosy images using mask-conditioned latent diffusion models and transfer learning from chronic wound datasets, aiming to address data scarcity for medical machine learning in neglected tropical diseases.

title: Don't Just Look, Intervene: Perturbation Based Region Labeling for VQA Images
summary: This paper introduces a perturbation-based region labeling method for Vision Question Answering (VQA) images, aiming to generate model-causal visual evidence to improve the grounding and interpretability of Vision Language Models (VLMs).

title: What Does the Encoder Actually Decide? A Controlled Comparison of Vision Backbones on Joint Tree Segmentation and Stereo Depth
summary: This research paper compares the performance of various vision backbones for joint tree segmentation and stereo depth estimation, particularly relevant for robotic tree pruning. It investigates the impact of encoder choice on performance under controlled conditions.

title: EMCStereo: Attention-Enhanced Stereo Matching for Thin-Structure Depth Estimation with a Synthetic Tree-Branch Benchmark
summary: This paper introduces EMCStereo, an attention-enhanced stereo matching method designed for accurate depth estimation of thin structures like tree branches. It also presents a synthetic tree-branch benchmark for evaluation.

title: Occlusal Geometry in Closed Form for Orthodontic Report Generation
summary: This research proposes a system for orthodontic report generation from intraoral data by exploiting directly measurable occlusal quantities from registered scan pairs. This approach aims to provide more direct measurements rather than inferring quantities.

title: Abstract-LoRA: Unlocking Single-Image Style Transfer through Targeted U-Net Block Training
summary: This paper introduces Abstract-LoRA, a method that enhances single-image style transfer using diffusion models by applying targeted training to specific U-Net blocks. It aims to improve the efficiency and quality of style transfer from a single image.

title: ArtSociety: Multi-Agent Multimodal Collaboration for Art Emotion Understanding
summary: This research introduces ArtSociety, a system employing multi-agent multimodal collaboration to tackle the AffectiveArt Multidimensional Art Emotion Understanding task. It aims to understand art emotions by combining multiple AI agents.

title: SJD-SV: Speculative Jacobi Decoding with Semantics Verification for Autoregressive Image Generation
summary: This paper introduces SJD-SV (Speculative Jacobi Decoding with Semantics Verification), a method designed to accelerate autoregressive image generation. It aims to address the token ambiguity issue commonly found in speculative decoding approaches.

title: Pixel-wise Planarity for High-Precision Monocular Plane Segmentation
summary: This research proposes a pixel-wise planarity prediction framework for robust and high-precision monocular plane segmentation from single RGB images. It aims to overcome issues of imprecise region grouping and geometric inconsistencies.

title: Evaluation of MLLM-Agnostic Plug-and-Play Keyframe Selection Methods for Long Video Understanding
summary: This research evaluates various MLLM-agnostic plug-and-play keyframe selection methods designed to improve multimodal large language models' understanding of long videos. It addresses the computational limitations of MLLMs when processing extensive visual data.

title: Preserving Subject-Clarity in Image Outpainting with Multiscale Wavelet Supervision
summary: This paper presents a method using multiscale wavelet supervision to preserve subject clarity in image outpainting, particularly for commercial and advertising images. It aims to address issues like poor framing and cropped subjects in generative image tasks.

title: (How) Do MLLMs Report Bistable Images Like Humans?
summary: This research investigates whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) report bistable images similarly to humans and explores the internal computations involved. It compares MLLM interpretation patterns with human perception of ambiguous stimuli.

title: A Comprehensive Review of Multimodal Facial State Analysis: Tasks, Methods, and Resources
summary: This paper provides a comprehensive review of multimodal facial state analysis, covering various tasks, methods, and resources in the field. It discusses the challenges of traditional unimodal approaches and the benefits of multimodal analysis.

title: Sampling headroom is not selection gain: a compute-value audit of test-time scaling for video world models
summary: This research conducts a compute-value audit of test-time scaling (TTS) for video world models, analyzing whether additional computational effort consistently leads to better generation quality. It distinguishes between sampling headroom and selection gain in model performance.

title: Interpretable Temporal Video Reasoning with EventGraph and EventField
summary: This research presents a structured temporal video reasoning pipeline built around a discrete EventGraph, a continuous EventField, and a human-readable EventGlyph view. It achieves high accuracy on a calibrated EPIC-KITCHENS dataset.

title: TryOnReward: Learning Foveated Consistency for Reinforcement Fine-Tuning of Virtual Try-On
summary: This paper introduces TryOnReward, a method that uses reinforcement fine-tuning with foveated consistency to improve virtual try-on (VTON) systems. It aims to align VTON output with human preferences by learning a robust scoring function.

title: Filling the Unseen: Scene Extrapolation via 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: This research explores scene extrapolation via 3D Gaussian Splatting to address its degradation on out-of-distribution novel views and fill unseen regions. It aims to improve photorealistic reconstruction beyond the training view distribution.

title: Multi-View Structure-from-Motion Enables Oriented Projective Shape Analysis in Three Dimensions
summary: This research presents a geometric framework using multi-view Structure-from-Motion to enable oriented projective shape analysis in three dimensions. It provides a method for studying landmark configurations in digital images from pinhole cameras.

title: BEACON: Behavior and Appearance Control for Subject-Specific Video Generation
summary: This paper introduces BEACON, a method for subject-specific video generation that preserves both visual identity and person-specific expressive behaviors. It aims to replicate both appearance and characteristic facial expressions in generated human-centric videos.

title: Forward-Facing Near-Infrared Adds Little to Colour for Farm-Machinery Traversability: A Site-Disjoint Evaluation of Sensor-Dependent Spatial Leakage
summary: This research evaluates whether forward-facing near-infrared imaging offers significant advantages over color cameras for farm-machinery traversability. The study highlights that NIR adds little benefit when spatial data leakage from prior benchmarks is eliminated.

title: Structure-Token Evidence-Anchored Reasoning for Scientific Chart Understanding
summary: This research proposes a Structure-Token Evidence-Anchored Reasoning method to improve large vision-language models' understanding of scientific charts. It aims to overcome limitations where VLMs treat charts as natural photographs rather than structured data.

title: Capability-Routed Visual Retrieval and Evidence Threading for Long-Context Document Question Answering
summary: This research introduces a method combining capability-routed visual retrieval and evidence threading to improve long-context document question answering. It aims to extract information from complex documents like annual reports by leveraging visual data and a frozen large vision-language model.

title: CANAL: Channel-Aware Noise Allocation for Differentially Private Feature Distillation in Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Introduces CANAL, a method for differentially private feature distillation in medical image segmentation to overcome privacy issues in sharing diverse training data. It allows hospitals to share learned feature representations instead of raw images.

title: SomBench: Benchmark Dataset for Advancing Machine Learning in Lunar Science
summary: Presents SomBench, a new benchmark dataset for advancing machine learning in lunar science. It aims to address heterogeneity in lunar orbital mission observations for reproducible ML.

title: RxScribe Bench: A Multi-Axis Benchmark for Evaluating Vision-Language Models on Indian Outpatient Prescriptions
summary: Introduces RxScribe Bench, a multi-axis benchmark designed to evaluate vision-language models on the task of transcribing Indian outpatient prescriptions. It highlights different clinical risks associated with various types of transcription errors.

title: Multimodal-Multiresolution Foundation Model for Lunar Remote Sensing
summary: Presents a new multimodal foundation model for lunar remote sensing, pretrained on a large corpus of co-registered tile bundles. The model utilizes 11 modalities at two spatial scales for comprehensive data analysis.

title: LLaDA-UI: Bringing Block-wise Diffusion to Vision-Language GUI Agents
summary: Explores applying block-wise diffusion to vision-language GUI agents, enabling high decoding efficiency for latency-sensitive applications. This paradigm is suitable for agents that repeatedly perceive screen states and emit actions.

title: Target-Checked Reliability Score Refinement for Video Question Answering
summary: Investigates methods to improve answer-level reliability scores for video-language models in question answering tasks. The goal is to refine confidence scores under target shift without retraining the models.

title: Harnessing Image Question Dependence for Better VLM Test-time Reinforcement Learning
summary: Analyzes how image-question dependence can improve test-time reinforcement learning for vision-language models (VLMs). The research focuses on the reliability of self-generated learning signals.

title: Variational Template Matching with Statistical Fusion for Anomaly Detection in Patterned Structures
summary: Proposes a novel variational template matching method with statistical fusion for anomaly detection in structured images. This approach offers robustness to geometric variations, addressing challenges in small-data settings.

title: Adaptive Conformal Redistribution for Inter-class Transitional Uncertainty in Medical Image Classification
summary: Presents a method called Adaptive Conformal Redistribution to address inter-class transitional uncertainty in medical image classification. It aims to make uncertainty-aware prediction sets more actionable in clinical settings.

title: HGSQ: Heatmap-Guided Sparse Query Detector for Real-Time Aerial Small Object Detection
summary: Introduces HGSQ, a Heatmap-Guided Sparse Query Detector designed for real-time aerial small object detection. It aims to preserve fine-grained localization while avoiding redundant computation on large background regions.

title: GroundBench: A Factorized, Counterfactual Benchmark for Locating VLM Affordance Failures
summary: Presents GroundBench, a factorized, counterfactual benchmark for identifying affordance failures in vision-language models (VLMs). It evaluates how naming target parts impacts action accuracy in manipulation prompts.

title: Task-Based CT Protocol Optimization Using Reinforcement Learning and Virtual Imaging Trials
summary: Proposes a virtual imaging trial framework with reinforcement learning for optimizing CT protocols. The method aims to improve diagnostic image quality and reduce radiation dose, addressing the complexity of parameter interdependence.

title: Pedestrian Crossing Intent Classification From Event-Based Vision Using Convolutional Spiking Neural Networks With Temporal Augmentation
summary: Develops a method for pedestrian crossing intent classification using convolutional spiking neural networks with temporal augmentation for autonomous vehicles. This aims for real-time inference under challenging conditions like motion blur.

title: Global-Local Contextual Progressive Expansion Network for Martian Landslide Segmentation in Multimodal Remote Sensing Imagery
summary: Presents a Global-Local Contextual Progressive Expansion Network for automated Martian landslide segmentation using multimodal remote sensing imagery. This advances understanding of Martian surface processes for space exploration.

title: ProtoCAM: Interpretable Few-Shot Mask-Guided Prototypical Learning for Breast Lesion Classification in Ultrasound Imaging
summary: Introduces ProtoCAM, an interpretable few-shot mask-guided prototypical learning method for breast lesion classification in ultrasound imaging. It addresses challenges of limited annotated medical data for reliable deep learning models.

title: RIGOR: Rig-Informed Geometry for Omnidirectional Reconstruction
summary: Presents RIGOR, a method for rig-informed geometry that improves omnidirectional 3D reconstruction from image streams. It aims to maintain consistency over long trajectories in challenging environments.

title: From Advertised Improvements to Measured Capabilities: Evaluating ChatGPT Images 2.5 on Forgery Tasks
summary: Evaluates the performance of ChatGPT Images 2.5 on forgery detection tasks, comparing its advertised improvements to its measured capabilities. It uses specific scenarios like receipt-field edits and product placement for assessment.

title: Multimodal Foundation Models Adaptation based on Domain-Aware Relaxed Orthogonal Subspace for Remote Sensing
summary: Proposes a domain-aware relaxed orthogonal subspace method for adapting multimodal foundation models for remote sensing. This parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) approach aims to reduce high fine-tuning costs.

title: MARC: Morphology-Aware Regression of Consensus for Cell Segmentation in Subcellular Spatial Transcriptomics
summary: Introduces MARC, a morphology-aware regression of consensus method for accurate cell segmentation in subcellular spatial transcriptomics. This addresses a major bottleneck in partitioning tissues into individual cellular instances.

title: FFVO: A Feedforward Pose Decoder for Long-Horizon Visual Odometry
summary: Develops FFVO, a feedforward pose decoder for long-horizon visual odometry, which is fundamental for autonomous driving systems. It aims to address computational cost and context ambiguity in stable 4D spatial understanding.

title: Hyper-LLaVA: Hyperbolic Uncertainty-aware Modality-Balanced Routing for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
summary: This introduces Hyper-LLaVA, a new multimodal AI model that uses hyperbolic uncertainty-aware and modality-balanced routing for continual instruction tuning.

title: Restore What Matters: Lessons from Joint Restoration and Recognition
summary: This proposes a Joint Restoration-for-Recognition (JR$^2$) paradigm, a novel method for image restoration and recognition that focuses on restoring only what is necessary for downstream tasks.

title: StepPrune: Adaptive Sequential Visual Token Selection across Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: This presents StepPrune, an adaptive sequential visual token selection method designed to accelerate inference in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) by pruning visual prefixes.

title: Realtime-Venus: A full-duplex interaction system with asynchronous delegation
summary: This presents Realtime-Venus, a proactive full-duplex interaction system with asynchronous delegation designed for natural interaction in digital and physical environments using acoustic, linguistic, and visual cues.

title: Seeing What the Vehicle Sees: Video-Augmented Virtual Reality for Physical Autonomous Vehicles
summary: This explores using video-augmented virtual reality (VR) to help passengers understand what an autonomous vehicle perceives and why it acts in certain ways.

title: ShieldVLA: Feasibility-Aware Safety Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: This introduces ShieldVLA, a feasibility-aware safety alignment method for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, aimed at providing stronger safety guarantees for robotic manipulation and navigation.

title: Harnessing human expertise for high-precision robotic assembly in industrialized construction: A sample-efficient installer-in-the-loop interactive reinforcement learning framework
summary: This describes an interactive reinforcement learning framework that leverages human expertise for high-precision robotic assembly tasks in industrialized construction.

title: Self-Evolving AI for Humanoids: Mechanisms, Safety, and Evaluation of Post-Deployment Self-Improvement
summary: This discusses mechanisms, safety considerations, and evaluation methods for self-evolving AI that enables post-deployment self-improvement in humanoid robots.

title: GzDRL: Reproducible and Scalable Deep Reinforcement Learning with Gazebo
summary: This introduces GzDRL, a novel single-process deep reinforcement learning framework for Gazebo that addresses reproducibility and scalability issues in robotics experimentation.

title: Extending the Speed Limit of Quadrupedal Locomotion via Refined Actuator Modeling and Adaptive Command Scheduling
summary: This focuses on extending the speed limit of quadrupedal robot locomotion through refined actuator modeling and adaptive command scheduling.

title: Breaking speed scaling in quadrupedal robots via Huygens' coupled-pendulum dynamics
summary: This explores breaking speed scaling limits in quadrupedal robots by applying Huygens' coupled-pendulum dynamics to improve control algorithms.

title: Ergodic Control and Controlled Diffusion for Robot Learning: Review and Tutorial
summary: This paper provides a review and tutorial on Ergodic Control and Controlled Diffusion methods, specifically highlighting their applications in robot learning.

title: IMM-based Multiple Object Tracking using a State Prediction Neural Network
summary: This proposes an IMM-based multiple object tracking method using a state prediction neural network, primarily for autonomous vehicles to enhance obstacle avoidance and route planning.

title: Attention-DP3: Spatially Object-aware 3D Diffusion Policy via Geometry-aligned Attentional Conditioning
summary: This presents Attention-DP3, a spatially object-aware 3D diffusion policy designed to improve localization and exploitation of task-relevant geometry in robotic manipulation scenes using point-cloud observations.

title: Bridging Thought and Action: Taming Long-Horizon Instability in Open-Source LLM Agents with a MetaTool-Enhanced ROS Framework
summary: This introduces a MetaTool-Enhanced ROS Framework to improve open-source LLM agents, addressing long-horizon instability and inefficient action execution in agentic robotic systems.

title: Constraint-Grounded Reinforcement Learning for Variable Impedance Control in Contact-Rich Robotic Insertion
summary: This details a Constraint-Grounded Reinforcement Learning approach for variable impedance control, aimed at improving robotic insertion tasks under uncertain contact conditions.

title: Runtime-Incremental Transformer for Reinforcement-Learning-Based Adaptive Control
summary: This describes a Runtime-Incremental Transformer for reinforcement-learning-based adaptive control of robotic manipulators, addressing challenges with non-observable friction memory.

title: An MRI-Guided Robotic System to Improve Hippocampal Access for Epilepsy Interventions
summary: This presents an MRI-guided robotic system designed to improve hippocampal access for epilepsy interventions by precisely delivering a curved needle-like laser ablator.

title: From Vision to Harvest: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Multi-Arm Robotic Fruit Harvesting
summary: This focuses on benchmarking Vision-Language Models for multi-arm robotic fruit harvesting, aiming to improve efficiency and coordination in agricultural robotics.

title: How Well Do Pseudo-Rigid Body Models Capture Real Plants? In-Field Validation of Simulated Blueberry Canes
summary: This study focuses on the in-field validation of pseudo-rigid body models to accurately capture the physical behavior of real plants, such as blueberry canes, for robotic interaction.

title: Does Online Gravity Estimation Matter? Revisiting a Silent Design Split in LiDAR-Inertial Odometry
summary: This research paper evaluates whether online gravity estimation impacts LiDAR-inertial odometry systems, comparing different configurations in popular LIO frameworks like FAST-LIO2 and LIO-SAM.

title: How to Better Train VLAs: Lessons Learned From the REAL-I Challenge at ICRA 2026
summary: This paper discusses lessons learned from the REAL-I Challenge at ICRA 2026, focusing on effective training of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) robot policies using fixed demonstration budgets on dual-arm humanoid platforms.

title: GROOVE: Geometry-Guided Reduction of Operational-Space Jerk in VLA Execution
summary: GROOVE is presented as an online regulator designed to reduce operational-space jerk in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) robot execution, addressing oscillatory motion and sharp actuator transients during chunked command execution.

title: Learning In-Hand Object Reaching to General 6D Poses
summary: This work explores methods for learning in-hand object reaching to general 6D poses, allowing multi-fingered dexterous hands to reconfigure grasped objects without releasing them, improving manipulation efficiency.

title: Force-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Hybrid Sensorless Force Estimation for Wheeled-Legged Loco-Manipulation
summary: This research introduces force-aware reinforcement learning with hybrid sensorless force estimation for wheeled-legged loco-manipulation, addressing the challenge of coordinating locomotion and arm motion with interaction forces in robots.

title: GeomVLA: Unifying Scene, Motion, and Action in 3D
summary: GeomVLA is a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model that unifies perception, latent scene motion prediction, and action generation within a shared robot-centric 3D coordinate frame, leveraging pretrained VLM features.

title: LePlanner: An Iterative Amortized Controller For World Models
summary: LePlanner proposes an iterative amortized controller for world models, designed to improve planning in compact latent representations learned from physical interaction, addressing the high cost of traditional search-based planners.

title: ReWeight: Leveraging Human Data for VLA Post-Training via Demonstration Retrieval and Sample Weighting
summary: ReWeight describes a method for post-training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for robots by leveraging human demonstration data through retrieval and sample weighting to address the cost of collecting robot-specific data.

title: Co-Speech with You: Training-Free Personalization of Robot Co-Speech Gestures
summary: This work presents a training-free personalization pipeline for personal robots to adapt co-speech gesture styles to new users, combining a frozen audio-conditioned diffusion prior with a gesture style encoder and conditioning adapters.

title: Rethinking the Implications of Human Feedback for Preference Learning in Human-Robot Collaboration
summary: This paper rethinks how human feedback is used for preference learning in Human-Robot Interaction, focusing on how robots can better learn reward models that represent human preferences for their behavior.

title: What Makes an Efficient VLA? Navigating Action-Head Design, Scaling, and Latency
summary: This study investigates the components that contribute to the efficiency of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, analyzing action-head design, scaling, and latency using specific backbones like SigLIP2 and Qwen2.5.

title: Gradient-Free Neural Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability for Scalable Safety-Critical Control
summary: This research proposes a gradient-free neural Hamilton-Jacobi reachability method for scalable safety-critical control, aiming to synthesize safety certificates and robust controllers for complex robotic systems.

title: Vision-Force Admittance Learning for Peg Insertion into a Movable Hole
summary: This work explores Vision-Force Admittance Learning for precise peg insertion into a movable hole, addressing the challenge of manipulation in dynamic environments caused by mobile robot bases or moving targets.

title: When Faster VLA Deployment Changes Closed-Loop Behavior: Task Success-Latency Analysis of SmolVLA Across PyTorch and ONNX Variants
summary: This analysis evaluates how VLA deployment, specifically SmolVLA, impacts closed-loop task behavior and latency within the LIBERO robotics benchmark, comparing PyTorch and ONNX runtime variants.

title: Visible Touch: Rendering Contact for Visuomotor Policies
summary: This research explores integrating contact information, termed 'Visible Touch,' into visuomotor policies to enhance robust manipulation, addressing the limitation of most policies relying solely on vision and proprioception.

title: GIFT: Glove-Inferred Force Transfer: Force-Aware Human-to-Robot Skill Transfer from a Wearable Sensing Glove to a Robot Hand Without Tactile Sensors
summary: GIFT (Glove-Inferred Force Transfer) is a pipeline enabling force-aware human-to-robot skill transfer from a wearable sensing glove to a robot hand without requiring tactile sensors on the robot.

title: DreamSat-Bench: Development and Initial Testing of a Testbed for AI-Based Pose Estimation from 3D Reconstruction
summary: DreamSat-Bench describes a new modular testbed for AI-based pose estimation from 3D reconstruction, designed for rendezvous and proximity operations, featuring a software- and hardware-in-the-loop robotic pipeline.

title: Task-Specified Active Metrological Inspection with Measurement-Steered VLA Manipulation and Deterministic Evidence Gating
summary: This work introduces task-specified active metrological inspection using measurement-steered Vision-Language-Action (VLA) manipulation and deterministic evidence gating for general-purpose robot agents in high-mix low-volume manufacturing.

title: VGFM: Expressive Robot Policies via Dense Value Guidance in Flow Matching
summary: VGFM presents a method for creating expressive robot policies through dense value guidance in flow matching, leveraging large offline datasets of robotic interactions to achieve complex robotic control.

title: Learning Communication-Conditioned Generative Policies for Decentralized Multi-Agent Collision Avoidance
summary: This paper proposes a decentralized communication-conditioned generative framework for multi-agent collision avoidance, where agents generate short-horizon action sequences using a flow-matching policy trained from offline demonstrations.

title: Multi-Task Visual Perception Network with LLM Conditioning for Autonomous Navigation
summary: This research proposes a multi-task visual perception network with LLM conditioning to improve long-term autonomous navigation for service robots by addressing odometry drift and sensor error. It focuses on enhancing path planning algorithms for physical robots.

title: VLBiMan++: Expanding the Generalization Boundary of Vision-Language Anchored One-Shot Bimanual Manipulation
summary: This research introduces VLBiMan++, a method for vision-language anchored one-shot bimanual robotic manipulation designed to improve generalization across diverse tasks, objects, and scenes. It aims to reduce the need for extensive teleoperated demonstrations and policy retraining.

title: Learning-Based Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance for a UAV Using Only Three Range Sensors
summary: This paper presents a learning-based approach for kinodynamic online motion planning for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) to achieve dynamic obstacle avoidance using only three range sensors. The method enables real-time navigation in unknown environments with partial observability.

title: EMoG: Emotion-Modulated Gait Generation for Expressive Humanoid Locomotion
summary: This research proposes EMoG, an emotion-modulated gait generation framework for expressive humanoid locomotion, aiming to integrate expressiveness with explicit control. It moves beyond just stability and task execution in humanoid robots.

title: EcoBoat: Design and Experimental Validation of an Autonomous Body-Board Boat For Cleaning Water Bodies
summary: This paper presents EcoBoat, a low-cost autonomous surface vehicle designed for cleaning water bodies by collecting floating debris. The system is experimentally validated for its autonomous operation.

title: NavPatch: Evidence-Guided Object-Level Costmap Correction with Vision-Language Models
summary: This research introduces NavPatch, a method for evidence-guided object-level costmap correction using vision-language models to improve obstacle avoidance and path planning for mobile robots. It aims to refine how objects are represented in navigation maps for better decision-making.

title: GLAM: Training a latent world model over global spatiotemporal memory for active exploration and navigation
summary: This paper presents GLAM, a goal-conditioned latent world model that trains over global spatiotemporal memory to enable active exploration and semantic navigation for embodied AI agents. It focuses on how agents build and use memory from partial observations to plan future actions.

title: Learning Multi-Agent Task Assignment and Navigation in the Factory: from Simulation to Real Robots
summary: This paper investigates the real-world applicability of decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) for task assignment and navigation in multi-robot systems within industrial environments. It focuses on deploying learning-based solutions to physical robots.
